desc:
When you're so drunk, you forgot what your signature ability was. 🥴 Anywho, the more I think about Suika's ability, the more I think "***Wait, isn't she pretty overpowered?***"

I've played with interpretative power ideas before like "*What if Flandre can destroy not only physical objects, but abstract concepts too – like the fact that you're a Hōrai Immortal?*" – but Suika is exactly that. She can gather and scatter **anything**. Hell, I think she can even kill Mokō and toss her across the Sanzu River if she wants to by scattering that status effect.
